newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujicco, Aim Services apply for Tokyo listing.
newsitem.headline: Fujicco, Aim Services apply for Tokyo listing.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Friday that Fujicco Co Ltd and Aim Services Co Ltd had applied to the Ministry of Finance to list their shares on the Tokyo bourse.

Fujicco, a manufacturer and retailer of seaweed and bean foodstuffs, is planning to list on the second section of the exchange on December 27. It is already listed on the second section of the Osaka Securities Exchange.
Aim Services, a food distributor, plans to list on the second section on December 24, the TSE said in a statement.
